name: field-sales-management-system
description: Field sales force management: GPS attendance with geofencing & fraud detection, live rep tracking, sales targets, catalogue sharing. Flutter + React + NestJS + PostGIS, English/Arabic RTL. Live demo ↓

paragraphs: GPS attendance, live rep tracking, sales targets and a shareable product catalogue — a Flutter app for reps and a React portal for the admin, in English and Arabic.
▶ Try the live demo · Get it for your team · Screenshots · How it's built

Field sales teams are hard to manage from an office: who actually showed up, where is everyone right now, is anyone faking their location, and are we on track for this month? SFMS answers all four. It was built for ZONA's field sales team in Saudi Arabia and is deployed for them.
features: Reps check in with one tap. GPS, geofence and fraud checks run in the background, and the app
The admin sees everyone live on a map, reviews only the check-ins that look suspicious, sets
One-tap GPS check-in/out, validated against circle or polygon geofences per branch, team or rep
8-hour rule: arrive any time in a configurable window (e.g. 09:00–12:00); short days are flagged, never silently accepted

requirements.text: The admin creates every account and password — there is no self-signup — and can reset any password on the spot

Location pings outside a shift are rejected by a trigger; attendance history and the audit log are append-only; every status change must declare its cause; a finalized month is locked; there is exactly one admin account.
